amendment: v1.23 correction-block versus full-chain efficiency semantics
timing: After the circuit optimization and before any v1.23 HFSS build or solve.
change: Apply the stated 97% circuit-upper-bound efficiency gate to the new correction block. Retain launch-plus-block and actual-load 95% requirements as separate mandatory physical-chain gates.
reason: The frozen launch alone has approximately 95.27% insertion efficiency, so a 97% combined passive-chain requirement is physically impossible and was not the user-stated circuit-upper-bound criterion.
authorization_limit: At most one 10 GHz network-only physical S8 smoke; three-frequency and integrated HFSS remain locked.
